entries.6bcaa336598bf611: Under the mission of 'bringing people to the region, creating liveliness in the region and invigorating the people of the region', the company states that the Talent Solutions Business provides total support from recruitment planning through post-hire follow-up, and that the Staffing and Placement Business deploys region-focused personnel services in an integrated way. The company states that the Child Care Support Business will prioritize 'safety and security' in operations and expand new facilities, and that the Regional Capacity Creation Business will promote relocation and settlement and operate regional exchange hubs in cooperation with municipalities.

entries.89d37b1e4e200127: Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,021 million, up 7.7% from the previous year. By business, the Talent Solutions Business was ¥950 million, the Child Care Support Business was ¥606 million, the Staffing and Placement Business was ¥369 million, and the Regional Capacity Creation Business was ¥95 million. Talent Solutions Business declined due to a delay in the hiring plan for sales personnel, but the opening of after-school day service facilities and an increase in municipal projects led to overall growth.
